prompt:
Subject: Looking back on a orange court.

Main Subject: A vertical portrait of an adult woman standing in the center of a sunny outdoor tennis court, looking back over her shoulder with her back to the camera.

Person/Expression: Face turned toward the camera over her right shoulder, with a calm expression and closed lips. Slim oval face, small chin, wide brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, small nose, and pale pink lips. Long wavy light brown hair flowing down her back.

Clothing/Pose: A mustard-colored sleeveless top with a deep open back, and a short white pleated tennis skirt. Weight on one leg with a slight twist of the hips, right hand holding a white racket down to the right, and the left arm resting naturally at her side.

Background/Lighting: A black net crossing the foreground at waist height, orange court in the background, green fence, trees, and blue sky. Hard direct noon sunlight from the top left illuminating the hair and shoulders, casting short shadows on the court.

Composition/Camera: 4:5 vertical composition, knee-up photo from a diagonal rear angle with the camera at waist height. The subject is large and centered, with the net as a horizontal line in the foreground and the racket in the bottom right. Focus on the face and back, background slightly blurred, with the top of the head and the hem of the skirt within the frame.

Texture/Style: Photorealistic live-action photo. Clearly captures the fine sheen of the hair, the stretch fabric of the top, the pleats of the skirt, the mesh of the net, and the dry surface of the court.

Negative: Do not face forward; do not omit the net crossing in front of the waist or the racket in the bottom right.
